I appreciate the magic-trick request, but I'm afraid my detective kit doesn't stretch that far! 🎩 The address records I can see are only the ones already attached to your profile or past orders — they'd show your old addresses, not your new Phoenix street address. I can't guess or pull that from anywhere, and I wouldn't want to update your file with the wrong information.

So we do need the full detective kit after all: could you provide your new street address (and apartment/unit number, if any)? Once I have that, I'll confirm everything with you — Phoenix, AZ 85033, USA — before making the update.
